children: BOK Financial posted an August 2026 investor presentation and reported Q2 net income of $176.5 million while period-end loans rose to $27.1 billion.
Posted Investor Presentation to investor.bokf.com (Exhibit 99.1) for use with investors and analysts.
Q2 net income $176.5M, $2.92 diluted EPS; adjusted net income would be $156.5M ($2.59) excluding Visa B share gain and securities repositioning.
Period-end loans grew $896M sequentially to $27.1B, up 11.5% year-over-year; loan-to-deposit ratio 68%.
Assets under management or administration rose to $129.3B (up $5.7B); fiduciary assets $78.9B.
Strong credit and capital metrics: nonperforming assets $55M (0.20% of loans), allowance for credit losses $323M (1.19%), TCE 9.6%.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
